question: Can the existing marked channel and its fixed state select a common original marking, state and event law, and which supplied synthesis formulas survive original-source checks?
scope: Finite marked M4 channel, coherent endpoint dilation, and stationary covariant mixing counterprocesses with identical unperturbed interval channels. Native regulated g=0 scalar/charge histories are prior conditional results, not identified with M4 here.

Sämtliche ungestörten Phi^n, Fixzustand und Kovarianz bestimmen dennoch das Mehrzeitgesetz nicht: exakter ergodischer Gegenprozess mit Vier-Schritt-Differenz 1/3317760. Quellenprüfung korrigiert Alpha-Exponential, Fünfer-Intertwiner, Parent-Energieoffset und MaxEnt-Prämisse; bestätigt bedingte Paarkorrelation/Lüders-Folge und allgemeinen homogenen GKLS-Ausschluss auf M4. Vorhandenes reguliertes Ladungs-/Skalargedächtnis wird als positiver Anschluss wieder sichtbar.
summary_en: Coherent mark transport works without a classical record under repeated uses of the conditional channel. All unperturbed Phi powers, fixed state and covariance still fail to select a multitime law: an exact mixing counterprocess differs by 1/3317760 on a four-step event. Source audit corrects the alpha exponential, five-space intertwiner, parent energy offset and MaxEnt premise; confirms conditional pair correlation, the specified Luders sequence and a general homogeneous GKLS exclusion on M4. Existing regulated scalar/charge history memory is retained as a positive starting point.

Independent repeated uses only for the endpoint-dilation construction; independence is not inferred from Phi.
A given initial projector P; its physical selection is not derived.

positive_results: Under independent repeated uses, exact coherent endpoint mark P_hat_n V_n P = V_n P; environment ranks 6 at n=1 and 16 at n>=2.

Exact stationary S5-covariant mixing counterprocess shares all unperturbed Phi^n and I4/4 with independent steps but changes the resolved four-event probability by 1/3317760; all words up to length three agree.

The Choi rank jump 6 to 16 excludes every time-homogeneous finite-dimensional GKLS generator on the same M4, using the positive-time support theorem, an alternative proof of a project exclusion already established more generally for all positive powers in source-continuous-marked-time-search-20260922.
Original v1024 parent reproduces kappa(1)=-0.002883410704473316 and kappa prime(0)=-1/300; 26 original checks pass.

Existing regulated charge/scalar history memory and determinant solvers replay unchanged with 39 and 25 passing check groups; full-history convergence is a read prior proof, not a newly executed sum.
kills: Identifying the specified 4+1 quartic-code involution with the specified 3+2 RR involution by a five-dimensional isometric intertwiner; traces differ.
Selecting the complete event process solely from all unperturbed channel powers, fixed state, marked covariance and ergodicity.
Treating endpoint compression as a lossless substitute for arbitrary intermediate interventions.
The supplied alpha formula exp(-2/alpha) produces the quoted inverse alpha value; it does not, the original exp(-2 alpha) does.
The supplied constant +1/4 bright-block energy offset holds for every occupancy; it must be s/4.
Using the unrestricted full 16D Gibbs state as the exact rank-six Choi preparation without sector selection.

Construct a common ordered operator dictionary between the existing regulated scalar/charge histories, native source-register response and marked M4 process.
Original P1/P2 source, continuum, interacting chiral 3+1D physics and T1-T8 common closure.
